cases.situation: Renting in Chicago, lease says 60 days written notice. I want to be out Nov 30. The property manager is Denise at a small management company.
cases.reply:
Dear Denise,
I'm writing to give notice that I will be vacating 2217 N Oakley Ave, Unit 3B, with my tenancy ending on 30 November 2026, in line with the 60-day written notice requirement in section 14 of my lease. I'll pay November's rent as usual and return all keys and the fob on the 30th. Could we schedule the move-out inspection for that afternoon? Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice.
Thank you for making my time here so easy.
Marcus Lee
cases.note: Sent on 1 October at the latest to meet 60 days; check whether the lease wants email, letter or both.

cases.situation: Je suis propriétaire d'un T2 à Nantes, le bail se termine le 31 mai 2027 et ma fille va y habiter. Je veux prévenir les locataires, Julien et Sarah, avant d'envoyer la lettre recommandée.
cases.reply: Bonjour Julien et Sarah, je voulais vous prévenir personnellement avant le courrier officiel : je ne renouvellerai pas votre bail qui se termine le 31 mai 2027, car ma fille va venir habiter l'appartement. Vous recevrez le congé par lettre recommandée cette semaine, dans le délai de préavis prévu pour votre bail. Je sais qu'un déménagement est un vrai bouleversement, et je vous ferai volontiers une attestation de bon locataire. Si vous trouvez un logement plus tôt, dites-le-moi et on s'arrangera sur les dates.
cases.note: Ce message prévient, il ne remplace pas le congé officiel. Vérifiez le délai et la forme du congé auprès de l'ADIL avant l'envoi, car ils dépendent du type de bail.

cases.situation: 在上海租房，合同到明年3月，公司把我调去深圳，11月底就得走。房东是位王阿姨，合同写提前退租押金不退。想跟她商量一下。
cases.reply: 王阿姨您好，公司把我调到深圳工作，所以想跟您商量能不能在11月30日提前退租。我可以帮您找下一位租客，配合带看，房租一直交到新租客入住为止。押金的事也想跟您商量一个两边都合适的办法，这周六上午方便通个电话吗？
cases.note: 提前退租是请求不是通知：先把对方的损失补上，再谈押金。谈妥的内容一定要落到书面。

cases.situation: I emailed my landlord Mr Okoye yesterday giving a month's notice to leave my flat in Bristol on 28 October. He says it's invalid because it's a rolling tenancy and notice has to end on the last day of a rent period. Rent is due on the 15th. I think he's right.
cases.reply: Hi Mr Okoye, thanks for pointing that out. You're right that the notice should end on the last day of a rent period. Please treat this email as my notice to leave 7 Cotham Road, Flat 3, with the tenancy ending on Saturday 14 November 2026. I'll pay the rent due on 15 October as usual and return both sets of keys on the 14th. Could you confirm in writing that you've received this?
cases.note: When they're right about the rule, re-serve correctly straight away instead of arguing. Before re-serving, check the current minimum notice for your tenancy type with Shelter or Citizens Advice, since the rules can change and may require more than a month.

cases.situation: Three of us rent a house on a joint lease through Parkside Lettings (property manager Owen). My housemate Tomás is moving to Madrid at the end of November. Aoife and I want to stay, and our friend Hana wants to take his room.
cases.reply: Hi Owen, I'm writing on behalf of the tenants at 42 Linden Street. Tomás Ruiz is moving out at the end of November, and Aoife Byrne and I would like to stay on. Could we replace Tomás on the lease with a new tenant, Hana Mori, from Tuesday 1 December 2026? She can send her references and ID this week for your checks. Please let us know what paperwork you need, and whether Tomás should also give notice separately. Could you confirm the next steps in writing? Thanks, Maya Collins
cases.note: Changing a joint tenancy is a request, not a notice. Get the new arrangement confirmed in writing before Tomás hands back his keys, since one tenant's notice can end the whole tenancy in some places.

cases.situation: Ich wohne in Leipzig zur Miete, unbefristeter Vertrag, gesetzliche Kündigungsfrist drei Monate. Ich ziehe für einen neuen Job nach Hamburg und will zum 31. Dezember raus. Die Hausverwaltung ist Mahler Immobilien, zuständig ist Frau Brandt.
cases.reply:
Sehr geehrte Frau Brandt,
hiermit kündige ich das Mietverhältnis über die Wohnung Karl-Heine-Straße 48, 2. OG links, 04229 Leipzig, fristgerecht zum 31. Dezember 2026, gemäß der gesetzlichen Kündigungsfrist von drei Monaten (§ 573c BGB). Das unterschriebene Original geht Ihnen heute per Einschreiben zu. Für Besichtigungen mit Nachmietern bin ich werktags ab 17 Uhr flexibel. Für die Übergabe mit Zählerablesung schlage ich Montag, den 28. Dezember, vor. Bitte bestätigen Sie mir den Eingang der Kündigung schriftlich.
Vielen Dank für die angenehmen Jahre hier.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Jonas Weber
cases.note: Die E-Mail ist nur die Vorabinfo: Die Kündigung braucht in der Regel einen unterschriebenen Brief, der bis zum dritten Werktag im Oktober ankommen muss. Im Zweifel Mietvertrag prüfen oder beim Mieterverein nachfragen.

cases.situation: I asked my landlord Greg if I could end my lease on Nov 30 instead of March 31 because I'm moving to Denver for work. He replied 'A lease is a lease, you owe rent through March.' Rent is $1,850. I don't want a fight.
cases.reply: Hi Greg, I understand you'd rather keep the lease as it is, and I'm not asking you to lose money on the unit. Would you agree to release me from the lease once I find a replacement tenant who passes your usual checks? I'd keep paying the $1,850 rent until they move in, handle the listing and show the apartment around your schedule. If that works for you, I'm happy to put it in writing this week.
cases.note: After a no to leaving early, ask what would make it work; a vetted replacement answers his real worry. Get any deal in writing, and check your state's rules on a landlord's duty to re-let.

cases.situation: I rent my spare room to a lodger, Kofi, who's been with us 18 months, rent paid monthly on the 1st. My mum is moving in with us so I need the room back. Our agreement says one month's notice; I want to give him more and be kind about it. We're in the UK.
cases.reply: Hi Kofi, I'd like to talk this through with you in person too, but here is the notice in writing. My mum is moving in with us, so I need the spare room back, and I'm ending our lodging agreement on Monday 30 November. That's two months rather than the one month in our agreement, to give you proper time to find somewhere. Your rent stays as it is until then, and we can agree a time for the handover nearer the date. I'm very happy to be a reference, and you've been a great person to share the house with. Could you confirm you've received this?
cases.note: A lodger in your home still gets exact dates in writing; giving more than the minimum notice and a reference is what keeps it kind.

cases.situation: Vivo de alquiler en Madrid desde marzo de 2025, con un propietario particular, don Alfonso. El contrato pide 30 días de preaviso por escrito. Me mudo a Valencia por trabajo y quiero dejar el piso el 31 de octubre.
cases.reply:
Estimado don Alfonso:
Le comunico que dejaré la vivienda de la calle Embajadores 112, 3.º B, y que el contrato terminará el 31 de octubre de 2026, conforme al preaviso de 30 días de la cláusula 4. Le envío también este aviso por burofax para que quede constancia. Pagaré el alquiler de octubre como siempre, y le propongo hacer la revisión del piso, la lectura de contadores y la entrega de llaves el sábado 31 a las 11:00. ¿Me podría confirmar por escrito que ha recibido este aviso?
Gracias por estos casi dos años, ha sido un placer.
Lucía Ortega
cases.note: Fecha exacta, cláusula y constancia por escrito primero; la amabilidad va al final. Si el contrato prevé una indemnización por salida anticipada, revísala antes de enviar.

cases.situation: 我在杭州有套两居室出租，租客小林住了三年，房租每次都按时交。合同12月31日到期，约定到期前一个月通知。我儿子明年结婚要住这里，不打算续租了。想先微信跟他说，再寄书面通知。
cases.reply: 小林你好，跟你说件事：我儿子明年结婚要住这套房，所以12月31日合同到期后就不续租了。合同约定提前一个月通知，我想早点告诉你，好让你有足够时间找房，正式的书面通知这周寄给你。如果你找到房子想提前搬，跟我说一声，日期一起商量，房租按实际住的天数算。交房那天我们一起验房、抄水电燃气表，押金当场退。这三年你一直按时交租，新房东需要证明的话我随时帮你写。收到麻烦回我一下。
cases.note: 房东不续租：到期日写清楚、理由一句、提前量多于合同要求，再把验房、退押金和推荐这些实际帮助说明白，并请对方确认收到。

cases.situation: Renting a unit in Brunswick, Melbourne, now on a periodic agreement that says 28 days' written notice. We want to leave Nov 30. I work night shifts and we have a 3-month-old, so I also want to ask the agent, Priya at Northside Realty, to keep viewings to set times.
cases.reply:
Dear Priya,
I'm writing to give notice that we will vacate 3/41 Albert Street, Brunswick, on Monday 30 November, in line with the 28 days' written notice in our rental agreement. Rent will be paid through to the 30th, and we'll hand back all keys at the final inspection that day if that suits. One request about viewings: I work night shifts and we have a three-month-old, so could they be kept to Tuesdays and Saturdays between 11am and 1pm, with the usual notice? We'll have the place tidy for them. Please confirm you've received this notice. Thanks for your help while we've been here.
Sam Nguyen
cases.note: The notice stands on its own in the first sentence; the viewing times are a separate request, so a no on those doesn't muddy the notice.

cases.situation: 東京の賃貸マンションに住んでいます。契約書では解約は1ヶ月前までに書面で通知することになっています。転勤で11月30日に退去したいです。管理会社はさくら不動産の佐藤さんで、まずメールで連絡したいです。
cases.reply:
さくら不動産 佐藤様
いつもお世話になっております。メゾン中野302号室の山田健太です。転勤のため、賃貸借契約を2026年11月30日（月）をもって解約したく、ご連絡いたしました。契約書第12条の「1ヶ月前までに書面で通知」に沿って手続きしたいので、所定の解約通知書をお送りいただけますでしょうか。届き次第記入し、今週中に返送いたします。退去立会いは11月30日の午前中を希望しております。本メールを受け取られた旨、ご返信いただけますと幸いです。
これまで大変お世話になりました。
山田健太
cases.note: メールは事前連絡。契約書が書面を求めているなら、解約通知書が期限までに届いて初めて有効になるので、控えも残しておく。

cases.situation: My apartment lease in Austin ends Dec 31. It auto-renews month-to-month at $150 more unless I give written notice at least 60 days before the end date. The complex is run by Cedar Point Residential; there's a notice-to-vacate form in the resident portal, but I also want to email the leasing manager, Tasha.
cases.reply:
Hi Tasha,
I'm writing to give notice that I will not renew my lease for 1840 Riverside Dr, Apt 2214, and will vacate on Thursday 31 December 2026, the end date of the current lease. This meets the 60-day written notice in section 3 of the lease, and I've also submitted the notice-to-vacate form in the resident portal today, so please don't convert the lease to month-to-month. I'll pay December's rent as usual and would like to book the move-out inspection for the afternoon of the 31st. My forwarding address for the deposit is 522 Maple Lane, Round Rock, TX 78664. Could you confirm in writing that you've received this notice?
Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz
cases.note: With an auto-renewal clause, say 'will not renew' in the first line, serve it every way the lease allows, and screenshot the portal submission.

cases.situation: I run a small bakery in a strip-mall unit. My 5-year commercial lease ends January 31, 2027, and it renews for another 5 years unless I give 90 days' written notice by certified mail. We're moving to a bigger space. The landlord is Harbor Plaza LLC; the property manager is Glen Morris.
cases.reply:
Dear Mr Morris,
I'm writing to give notice that Rise & Crumb Bakery will not renew its lease for Unit 7, Harbor Plaza, and will vacate at the end of the current term on Sunday 31 January 2027. This is the 90 days' written notice required under section 22 of the lease, and a signed copy is going to you today by certified mail. Rent will be paid through January, and we'll return the unit in the condition the lease's surrender clause sets out. Could we schedule a walkthrough in mid-January to agree on anything that needs doing before we leave? Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice.
Thank you for five good years at Harbor Plaza.
Ana Duarte, Owner
cases.note: With a long auto-renewal on a commercial lease, serve notice exactly as the lease says, keep the mail receipt, and have someone check the surrender clause.

cases.situation: My dad died on September 18. He rented a flat in Glasgow from a private landlord, Mrs Duncan, for 11 years. I'm his executor and need to end the tenancy and clear the flat, but I don't know what notice applies.
cases.reply:
Dear Mrs Duncan,
I'm sorry to tell you that my father, Robert Mackay, died on 18 September. As the executor of his estate, I'm writing to give notice to end his tenancy at 14 Hyndland Road, Flat 1/2. Could you let me know the notice period and end date you'll be working from, and whether you need a copy of the death certificate or anything else from me? I'm aiming to have the flat cleared and the keys back to you by Saturday 31 October, and I'm happy to do a check-out inspection with you that day. Please confirm in writing that you've received this.
Thank you for being his landlord all these years.
Yours sincerely,
Fiona Mackay
cases.note: Rules on ending a tenancy after a death vary by place and tenancy type; check with a local advice service before relying on a date.

cases.situation: I'm a landlord. My tenant Bea texted me on Monday Sept 28 that she's moving out on Oct 17. Our lease, clause 9, requires 30 days' written notice ending on the last day of a month, and rent is due on the 1st. I want to be clear about the dates without being harsh.
cases.reply: Hi Bea, thanks for letting me know, and good luck with the move. Under clause 9 of our lease, notice needs to be 30 days in writing and end on the last day of a month, so the earliest your tenancy can end is Saturday 31 October, with October's rent due on the 1st as usual. If a new tenant can move in before then, you'd only pay up to the day before they start, and I'm happy to begin viewings straight away. Could you email me to confirm 31 October as your end date, so we can book the check-out for that day?
cases.note: Landlord receiving short notice: the correct date with the clause, a way to cut her cost, and written confirmation. Check local rules before relying on the clause.

cases.situation: I rent an apartment in Portland from Mr Hale on a month-to-month agreement that says 30 days' written notice. He's ignored my requests to fix the heating for six weeks and I've had enough, so I'm leaving on October 31. I'm furious, but I want the notice clean and my deposit back.
cases.reply:
Dear Mr Hale,
I'm writing to give notice that I will be leaving 3318 SE Taylor St, Apt 4, with my tenancy ending on Saturday 31 October 2026, in line with the 30 days' written notice in our month-to-month agreement. I'll pay October's rent as usual and return both keys on the 31st. Could we arrange a move-out inspection that afternoon? I'll send my forwarding address for the deposit separately. Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice.
Kind regards,
Jenna Park
cases.note: Keep the heating complaint in its own message: a notice that doubles as a grievance invites an argument about the grievance. Check how the agreement says notice must be served.
